COURSE CODE     10BH1204

Objective:
 1  This advanced course on Public Speaking emphasizes on cultivating practical skill of
     public speaking in various forms of professional and social settings. The purpose is to
    groom students in typical public speaking situations and to provide them with the
     experience of public speaking.


Course Outcomes: After completion of this course, student will be able to:

 3  Develop strategies for effective public speaking offline and online environments
 4  Students will practice delivery of professional and personal speeches / presentations using

COURSE TITLE    CRITICAL THINKING & ARGUMENTATIVE SKILLS
COURSE CODE     10BH1206
COURSE CREDITS  3

Objective:
 1  To underscore the realization and importance of Critical thinking in academics
 2  To conduct various Practical exercises to inculcate skills and faculties so that they think
     logically and analytically.


Course Outcomes: After completion of this course, student will be able to:
 1  Identify the differences between fact and opinion
 2   Identify, compose and refute propositions of fact, value and policy
 3  Understand the methods of analyzing evidences in order to organize ,deliver and critique
     effective e arguments and rebuttals
 4  Analyze and utilize formal and informal logic to construct arguments which advocate or
    defend position(s).
 5  Utilize ethical communication when developing arguments while simultaneously taking
     into consideration diverse audiences


Pre-requisite of course:N/A
